title: Swagger UI documentation exposed in a response
description: The response renders Swagger UI: the page contains the swagger-ui element and the SwaggerUIBundle script that loads a specification. Published API documentation names every route, parameter and model, and in many deployments the specification file itself is readable next to it.
remediation: Serve the documentation only on an internal or authenticated path, and remove it from the production image when it is generated at build time.
limitation: Two body markers. A page that links to a documentation site is not matched; the UI assets must be rendered in the response.

observation.body: Our API documentation is published at developer.example.
